parameterProvenance.priceWeights: Entire nonnegative absolute-plus-ratio region constrained by confirmed owner choices; no model overrides or selected midpoint.
parameterProvenance.retainedScoreFraction: Provisional product quality-protection scenario: at most 20% loss of benchmark score; not 80% task ability. Chosen during development with existing feedback, not preregistered or independently validated.
parameterProvenance.boundaryProbePoints: Engineering stress probe, not a measurement confidence interval.
parameterProvenance.timePolicy: Declared auxiliary policy: time may change utility by at most one score point; 30-minute reference is a provisional scenario, not a fitted preference. Unknown timings remain unknown.
